about_the_game:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the fantastical world of Shuffle Waifu Cafe🍰, where fate makes you the manager of charming cafes. Demanding guests fill the halls, and it is up to your waitresses to serve them. With cards you shuffle your staff between tables, trying to satisfy every customer while getting closer to the girls who work for you: playful catgirls, alluring succubi, mysterious vampires and hot dragons!

💖 Build Romantic Bonds and Go on Dates

Spend time with your waifus outside of work. Go on dates, help them overcome their worries and discover their hidden sides. They will open up to you, and in return you will share a part of yourself with them.

🔥 Training Your Maids

Hire and train your cute maid waifus, raising their stats and increasing your cafe’s profits. The harder they work, the more possibilities open up for your cafes to grow.

🃏 Shuffle Your Waifus with Cards

Use cards to assign the right girl to the right table. Smart choices will help your cafe grow and may even save the world of mortals from a terrible fate.

🍰 Grow Your Cafes

Upgrade your cafes, unlock special events and enjoy the balance of management, card mechanics and romance in a warm anime atmosphere.

Shuffle Waifu Cafe🍰 is more than just management. It’s about trust, romance and the unforgettable moments you share with the girls who stand by your side.

content_descriptors.notes: The player can meet characters in revealing costumes.
